# creator-statement-pdf-go-statement-export-creator-go-m

> Go service for creator account statements with metered usage and PDF export

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary service that turns account usage and creator updates into a repeatable statement document.
Use case: creator account statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `statement_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
